name: PACE Backup SysID Adapter
description: Optional backup SysID boundary for leggedrobotics/pace-sim2real when Newton is unavailable or not preferred.
validators: PACE must consume portable commanded/measured joint-position records or a configured custom pace_command
PACE is a backup backend and should skip when Newton passes and is preferred
PACE fit.py is task-config driven, so a matching PACE task/data_dir or custom command is required
local log-based SysID remains the fallback when neither Newton nor PACE is configured
if config.sysid.require_pace is true, missing or low-confidence PACE output must fail
